notes.title: Devlog #01 - Butterflies!
notes.content:
Thank You for Your Support!
A huge thank you to everyone for the incredible support during Steam Next Fest 2025—we've officially reached 10,000 wishlists!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45202587/b2c52f7bc40971df507ef1aa0d471ba6203caea0.png

Introducing... Butterflies!
We're kicking off our monthly devlogs starting with something new: butterflies!

 Different butterfly species will now flutter around your garden.
 Catch them by interacting and successfully clearing the bug-catching minigame!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45202587/61920db21461d321a5ac643cce1eeab9569664bd.gif

Bug-Catching Minigame

A timing challenge that mimics the unpredictable movement of critters.
Complete the patterns with multiple times of well-timed clicks to successfully catch them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45202587/f72289df07d4053bd4b7a823646220c705dbc855.gif

Critters Collection Book & Rewards

 Successfully caught critters are added to your Critters Collection Book.
 Expanding your collection unlocks new bouquet decorations!
 The critters come in different rarities—get ready to Catch 'Em All!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45202587/91aaa733cad2e5bbd5a092b6cd9cab0206dc63bb.gif

This new feature will be available in the BloomTale Demo soon! 

We can't wait for you to try out the butterfly catching and see what you think. 
That's all for this month's devlog. Until next time, happy arranging!

What's Next?

 Bouquet Editor Update: Layering system & QoL improvements
 In-Game SNS: Share your bouquet with the world!
 Endless Mode: A new challenge for dedicated florists
 Localization System: Bringing BloomTale to more players globally
